verdicts.description: One verdict for each bullet, in the bullets' order

supported.description: true if everything the bullet says is stated in its cited sentences

changes_true.description: true if every claim that something was added, removed or changed is true against both documents (true if the bullet makes no such claim)

reads_well.description: true if the bullet reads as correct, plain English, each quotation fitting the grammar of the sentence around it

objection.description: Empty if all three answers are true; otherwise the bullet's words that fail and why, in one sentence
